summary: Phase 4 Advanced Automation + Part A fixes end-to-end review against live preview. Backend: project suite 72/72 pass via `cd /app/backend && pytest -c pytest.aegis.ini tests` (test_phase4 15/15). New agent suite /app/backend/tests_agent/test_phase4_review.py 27/27 pass covering: (Part A) LTP inheritance cards 61/44/186/291+38 with sum_check=true; search scoped to LTP returns control row with system_id=LTP; unscoped search groups by system_name (4 systems); decider on reviews/{id} ApprovalDecision list is a populated object with email+role (verified via submit→ISSM endorse→AO ATO_with_conditions decision). (Phase 4 content updates) overview shows DISA STIGs V1R1 installed + V1R2 available (sha256, items counts); preview diff_summary exactly {added:6, removed:3, changed_requirement:11, changed_severity:2} with impact.poams including P-0027 new_cat=CAT I and >=14 assets; ISSO POST /content-updates/{id}/apply → 403; ISSM apply → 200 with result.observations_rewritten==0 and history row status=applied/to_version=V1R2. (Scoring) finding breakdown points sum to score within 0.5; label contains 'not a formal residual risk determination'; ISSO PUT /risk/weights → 403; admin PUT weights → 200 with findings_rescored count. (OSCAL 1.2.2) poam, ssp, assessment-plan, assessment-results all generate valid schema-validated exports with evidence_id/sha256; GET /systems/{id}/oscal returns models + unsupported + limitations + oscal_version. (eMASS) status mode=mock; compare returns in_sync/different/local_only/remote_only buckets; oscal_export_only mode banner contains 'No live synchronization'; read mode returns real_connector_configured=false and all checks=false (truthful 'not configured'). (Scheduler) exactly 8 jobs with last_run_at/next_run_at/interval_minutes; run-now returns 2xx or 409 if already pending; PUT interval_minutes persists (requires enabled field too). (Mapping review) shape has pending+unmapped. (Regression) /poams /reviews /dashboard/leadership all 200. Frontend (Playwright, issm@LTP): Evidence Ledger /evidence-ledger renders 'Content updates (installed vs available)' panel with 'Demo OS STIG V1R2 ... V1R2' installed row + 'applied' history row (from this test apply) and SHA-256 columns. eMASS /emass renders MOCK banner 'MOCK connector - remote records are synthetic', Compare counts, Outbound change queue with the LTP authorization (ATO_with_conditions) create change auto-queued by trigger=authorization_decision from the agent test's decision (proves the 'approved authorization decision auto-queues proposed changes' acceptance). Mapping Review /mapping-review renders Pending review (0), Unmapped findings (16) with 'AI suggest mapping' buttons on every row. No fake / dead buttons observed on exercised pages. eMASS mode restored to 'mock' and failure sim 'off' in teardown.

(Low/cosmetic) Known from iteration_2: Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings on Portfolio trend chart - out of Phase 4 scope.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/app/api/v1/phase4.py content apply uses require_permission('content.apply') and the ISSM/platform.admin RBAC enforcement is correct; observations_rewritten==0 is the right invariant for 'never rewrites historical observations' and tested directly.

backend/app/services/risk.py – breakdown emitted as list of {reason_code, points, factor} summing to total.score; label 'not a formal residual risk determination' is embedded in /risk/weights and /findings/{id}/score responses as required.

backend/app/services/emass.py – read mode correctly reports real_connector_configured=false and all checks=false (application_registration, api_credential, client_certificate, user_authorization, base_url) – truthful 'not configured' admin panel acceptance met. oscal_export_only banner surfaces capabilities.live_sync=false.

backend/app/services/scheduler.py – 8 jobs seeded (kev refresh, content register, evidence freshness, poam SLA, risk recompute, mapping as-of, eMASS retry, demo heartbeat per visible UI); run-now returns 409 when already pending which is tested.

backend/app/api/v1/phase4.py ScheduleIn requires both interval_minutes AND enabled; a GET-then-PUT pattern (preserving enabled) is required by the UI – the new EmassPage/AdminPhase4Panels in Phase4Pages.tsx do this correctly.

backend/app/api/v1/phase3.py (Part A) global search groups by system_name/group when system_id query param not supplied, else returns rows scoped to system_id – matches the Part A fix text. Inheritance cards 61/44/186 + 38 manual attestations == 291 with sum_check invariant.

Observed: an approved authorization_decision (ATO_with_conditions) auto-queued a 'LTP authorization (ATO_with_conditions)' outbound eMASS change with trigger='authorization_decision' – acceptance 'approved POA&M closure/authorization decision auto-queue proposed changes' is implemented and user-visible on /emass.

seed_data_creation: Agent run calls POST /api/v1/admin/demo/reset at the start. During tests: (1) applies V1R2 content update (promotes V-900118 → CAT I, supersedes V1R1); (2) submits an LTP authorization package, ISSM endorses, AO decides ATO_with_conditions (expiration 2027-06-30) – this also auto-queues one eMASS outbound change on /emass; (3) temporarily toggles /risk/weights.rf_severity +1 then restores; (4) temporarily edits scheduler job interval +1 then restores; (5) temporarily switches /emass/config to oscal_export_only and read then back to mock. All demo state is a Reset Demo away from clean. STIG V1R2 remains applied until the next POST /admin/demo/reset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend project tests MUST run with `-c pytest.aegis.ini tests` (uses aegisrmf_test DB). Agent suite in /app/backend/tests_agent/* uses the default pytest.ini and the live preview; run with: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://aegis-rmf-demo.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest tests_agent/test_phase4_review.py -v -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/phase4_review.xml`. The module-scope `tokens` fixture calls POST /admin/demo/reset first and restores eMASS mode='mock'/failure-sim='off' on teardown. Key API shapes discovered: /systems returns a bare list (keys include acronym, not code); /content-updates returns {types:[{content_type, installed:[{version,id,sha256,items,...}], available:[...]}], history:[...]}; preview response is a ContentUpdate dict with top-level id + diff_summary + impact.poams[].new_cat; /risk/weights PUT body is {weights:{reason_code:int}} (not a flat dict); /scheduled-jobs PUT requires both interval_minutes AND enabled; /emass/status in read mode returns {mode, real_connector_configured:false, checks:{application_registration,api_credential,client_certificate,user_authorization,base_url}=all false, capabilities:{read,write,live_sync}=all false}; authorization decision flow is submit (sysowner, implementation.write) → ISSM endorse (action='endorse' on /reviews/{id}/decisions) → AO decide via /systems/{id}/authorization-decision with {request_id, decision in ATO|ATO_with_conditions|IATT|DATO, expiration, rationale, conditions required for ATO_with_conditions}.
rca of the issue: No functional defects found in Phase 4 or Part A fixes. All acceptance criteria verified: Part A 1-5 (POA&M source_label non-policy, scoped vs grouped search, decider name+role object, workflow Implement/queue reasons consistent via shared definition, LTP inheritance 61/44/186+38); Content Updates V1R1→V1R2 with 6/3/11/2 diff + P-0027 CAT II→CAT I + ISSO 403/ISSM apply + observations_rewritten==0 + applied history; prioritization score breakdown sums to total + 'not a formal residual risk determination' + ISSO 403 PUT weights; OSCAL 1.2.2 four models all schema-validated; eMASS mock with buckets + truthful admin panel for read/oscal_export_only; 8 scheduler jobs with run-now/interval edit; Mapping Review page with pending+unmapped+AI suggest; auto-queue on authorization decision observed live in /emass UI.
